decisions.evidence: Overall, the presence of a primary aromatic amine together with a flat, aromatic character and aryl chlorides outweighs the mostly exposure-related descriptors, so the molecule is predicted to be mutagenic.

Taken together, the local analog set supports option (B): is mutagenic. Overall, the mutagenic structural alert outweighs the exposure-related counter-signals, so the molecule is best classified as mutagenic.
